ruleset.name: Nexus
ruleset.description: Nexus Core architecture guardrails (AGENTS.md section 2-3). Test classes are exempt.

rule.name: NexusSoqlMustUseUserMode
rule.message: SOQL must enforce WITH USER_MODE; system-mode rule facts belong in a *FactsSelector (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: Every static SOQL query in production Apex must include WITH USER_MODE, except in *FactsSelector classes.

rule.name: NexusFactsSelectorMustUseSystemMode
rule.message: *FactsSelector SOQL must use WITH SYSTEM_MODE: rule facts must not depend on the running user (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: Facts selectors evaluate business invariants, so every query declares WITH SYSTEM_MODE explicitly.

rule.name: NexusFactsSelectorWithoutSharing
rule.message: *FactsSelector classes must be declared without sharing; WITH SYSTEM_MODE still applies the class sharing mode (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: System-mode SOQL skips CRUD/FLS but inherits record sharing from the class, so facts selectors opt out of sharing explicitly.

rule.name: NexusSoqlOnlyInSelectors
rule.message: SOQL belongs in a *Selector class, not in services, controllers, invocables or triggers (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: Static SOQL may only appear inside classes whose name ends with Selector.

rule.name: NexusNoDynamicSoqlOutsideSelectors
rule.message: Dynamic SOQL (Database.query*) belongs in a *Selector class (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: Database.query, Database.queryWithBinds and Database.getQueryLocator may only be called from Selector classes.

rule.name: NexusTriggerMustDelegateToHandler
rule.message: Triggers must be one line: new SObjectTriggerHandler().run(); (AGENTS.md 2.1)
rule.description: A trigger body may contain only a single call to run() on a newly constructed handler.

rule.name: NexusInvocableResultEnvelope
rule.message: @InvocableMethod classes must define a Result class with isSuccess, errorCode, errorMessage and payload (AGENTS.md 3)
rule.description: Invocable actions exposed to Flow, Agentforce or MCP return the uniform typed result envelope.
